text:
Lena Ortiz: Hi all, quick onboarding snag. Plugged my M1 Pro into the office dock and Kandji shows 'SCEP challenge failed' and the profile never installs. Guest wifi works but corporate ethernet on the dock is behind a captive portal.

Marcus Nguyen: Welcome Lena! The docked ethernet sometimes hits the captive portal on first boot. Did you try connecting to Redwood-Staff wifi first and completing onboarding there?

Lena Ortiz: I tried but the docking station forces LAN and disables Wi-Fi until unplugged. I can't hotspot because the building blocks personal tethering on corp VLANs.

Devices Team: Ticket #RD-ONB-3127 created. Assigning a Devices Team tech. Can you run `profiles -P` and paste the output? Also check `sudo tail -n 200 /var/log/install.log` if you have sudo.

Lena Ortiz: No sudo yet. Here's `profiles -P` output (read-only):

```
profiles: installed configuration profiles
    none
```

Lena Ortiz: Also see repeated entries in Console app about 'SCEP: enrollment timed out' and 'network unreachable'.

Devices Team: Sounds like the device never reaches the CA. Two options: (A) temporary local admin for you to install the root CA and re-run enrollment over Ethernet, or (B) remap the dock port to the onboarding VLAN for 30 mins. Which do you prefer?

Lena Ortiz: Option A would be faster for me today. Need to run a cert install and re-trigger.

IT Bot: Provisioned temp-admin window (2 hours) for lena. Token ID td-879. Logged in ticket.

Lena Ortiz: Thanks. I ran:

```
curl -fsS -o /tmp/redwood-ca.pem https://pki.redwood.local/root.pem
sudo security add-trusted-cert -d -r trustRoot -k /Library/Keychains/System.keychain /tmp/redwood-ca.pem
```

Lena Ortiz: `security` returned 'certificate added'. Re-ran Kandji enroll and now shows 'profile installed pending policy'.

Marcus Nguyen: Nice. After profile installs, you should see an 802.1X profile and a machine cert under Profiles. Also double-check `sudo /usr/local/bin/kandji-agent status` if present.

Lena Ortiz: `kandji-agent` shows 'connected' but Zscaler device trust says 'not provisioned' and Okta prompts for device trust but fails with network error.

Devices Team: Try unplugging the dock, connect to Redwood-Staff wifi, finish Okta device trust, then re-dock. Sometimes Zscaler needs to establish identity over Wi-Fi first. If the dock disables Wi‑Fi, we'll temporarily remap the port.

Lena Ortiz: Unplugged, connected to staff wifi, reauthenticated Okta device trust — success. Re-docked and ethernet resumed. Kandji and Zscaler both show healthy. FileVault: `fdesetup status` -> FileVault On.

Marcus Nguyen: Great. Noted that temp-admin was used; it will auto-revoke. If you see any system extension prompts for VPN or networking, DM Devices Team and we'll pre-approve via Kandji.

Lena Ortiz: One last ask: need Rosetta for a legacy binary. Can I use temp sudo to run `softwareupdate --install-rosetta --agree-to-license`?

Devices Team: Approved within the temp window. Go ahead. We can also push Rosetta via policy if more folks need it.

Lena Ortiz: Rosetta installed. Docker and dev container work. Thanks everyone — see you at the standup! :wave:
